title: Old-Fashioned Fairy Tales
author: Juliana Horatia Ewing
description: "Old-Fashioned Fairy Tales" by Juliana Horatia Ewing is a collection of original fairy stories written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: Ewing's tales, while utilizing traditional elements of fairy drama, offer new narratives that delve into timeless themes of virtue, morality, and the human experience.

authorInfo.bio: Juliana Horatia Ewing (1841–1885) wrote Old-Fashioned Fairy Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
